Item 7A. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures about Market Risk
As of December 31, 2008, approximately $5.9 billion of our borrowings bore interest at fixed rates, and
therefore the fair value of these instruments is affected by changes in the market interest rates. The following
table presents our aggregate fixed rate debt obligations as of December 31, 2008 with corresponding weighted-
average interest rates sorted by maturity date and our aggregate variable rate debt obligations sorted by maturity
